nom: ma:nyo Deep Pore Cleansing Soda Foam

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one prone to oiliness around the T-zone, report it cuts through excess oil and leaves skin feeling instantly clean, with blackheads and clogged pores improving over weeks of use.
segments.dry: Two reviewers report the cleanser made their skin very dry, with one advising against it for anyone with dry skin and another, who also has sensitive, acne-prone, combination skin, developing a burning sensation and painful reaction.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, more-oily-in-summer skin and hormonal acne calls it a game changer for tightening skin and shrinking pores, though she warns it can be drying without a good moisturizer afterward; another with sensitive, acne-prone, dry-combination skin could not tolerate it at all.
segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive skin are split: two say it burned on contact, left skin painfully dry, and triggered inflamed acne or irritated bumps within days, including one with sensitive, acne-prone, dry-combination skin who found even a moisturizer afterward painful to apply; two other reviewers with sensitive skin, however, report no irritation at all and specifically note their sensitive skin was unaffected.

concerns.dehydration: Reports on dryness are sharply mixed: several reviewers, including two who found it very drying and one who could not tolerate even moisturizer afterward, report significant dehydration; several other reviewers report the opposite, that it cleanses deeply without stripping moisture or causing dryness at all, though a couple who like the product still recommend a good moisturizer afterward or limiting use to a few times a week as a precaution.
concerns.redness: One reviewer developed a red, raw patch of skin on her chin and upper lip after use, alongside irritated bumps; by contrast, most reviewers report no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: Three reviewers report the cleanser burned or damaged their skin: one developed a red, raw patch on her chin and upper lip along with irritated bumps she is still repairing, and two others describe burning on contact severe enough that even moisturizer afterward was painful to apply; most other reviewers, by contrast, report no irritation or damage at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin with fewer blackheads, breakouts, and clogged pores within two weeks to three months of regular use, including one with perioral dermatitis whose breakouts improved; one reviewer, however, reports the cleanser caused a flare-up of inflamed acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser effectively breaks down excess oil and sebum in the pores, leaving skin feeling instantly clean even when it felt extremely oily beforehand.

aspects.libelle: Small amount foams up a lot, goes a long way
Good value for the amount of product
Can sting eyes when rinsing off
Skin can look worse before it improves

extraits.texte: This cleanser was way too harsh for me. I have sensitive, acne prone, dry-combo skin. I tried it for a couple of days and could not handle it, it burned every time and it hurt to follow up with anything afterwards, even just moisturizer. It caused lots of inflammed acne to pop up.
my sensitive skin didnt agree. i like how well it lathered but my skin is so dry after use and it burns.

It does do the job of exfoliating your skin; however it burns. I noticed at first it burning my eyes after rinsing it off, but then I got a big red raw patch of skin on my chin and upper lip that also caused alot of irritated bumps to appear. Im now having to repair my skin. I really enjoy their oil balm cleanser, but not this product.

extraits.titre: BUY (if you have combination to oily skin)
extraits.texte: I have combination skin that tends to be more oily in the summer and I suffer from hormonal acne and large pores. This product is a complete game changer!! Makes skin feel very tight and youthful after cleansing. And pores? Practically gone. HOWEVER, please make sure to use a good/hydrating moisturizer after cleansing because it can be drying if not used properly.

I recently tried a cleansing foam that features soda as a key ingredient, and I'm impressed! The soda creates a gentle, bubbly lather that deeply cleanses my skin without stripping it of moisture. It feels refreshing and invigorating, leaving my skin feeling smooth, soft, and thoroughly clean. Even with my sensitive skin, I haven't experienced any irritation. It's great for those days when my skin needs a little extra purifying. If you're looking for a cleansing foam that offers a deep clean with a refreshing twist, this one is worth trying!

extraits.titre: Great for oily and feeling clean
extraits.texte: I bought this on sale and so glad I did! there are times when my face feels extremely oily and this makes it feel clean after, instantly. My husband, who rarely ever touches anything skincare, stole it from me! It is THAT good. I have less bumps and clogged pores, but not 100% gone, however I've been using it for about 3 months.

This stuff smells so good and makes my skin soft as ever. I love it. I'll never use anything else. I have perorial dermatitis and allergies and this didn't break me out it actually helped my breakouts. 10/10

reserve: With only 20 reviews total and roughly one in five describing burning or significant irritation, this is a small sample for judging how common the adverse reactions are relative to the largely positive majority.
